roles.name: Customer
roles.description: Healthcare-commerce customer. Domain services must enforce ownership and family-member authorization for every record.

roles.name: Caregiver
roles.description: Authorized caregiver acting for permitted family members or patients; consent and relationship checks remain mandatory.

roles.name: Doctor
roles.description: Practitioner managing assigned appointments, consultations, and prescriptions.

roles.name: Pharmacist
roles.description: Pharmacist verifying prescriptions and recording medicine dispensing.

roles.name: Pharmacy Manager
roles.description: Pharmacy supervisor responsible for stock, orders, and dispensing approvals.

roles.name: Lab Technician
roles.description: Diagnostic technician collecting and processing samples and recording results.

roles.name: Pathologist
roles.description: Authorized clinical reviewer verifying and releasing diagnostic reports.

roles.name: Lab Manager
roles.description: Diagnostic-lab supervisor maintaining offerings and operational workflows.

roles.name: Warehouse Receiver
roles.description: Warehouse staff receiving goods and completing receiving quality checks.

roles.name: Warehouse Picker
roles.description: Warehouse staff executing assigned picking work.

roles.name: Warehouse Packer
roles.description: Warehouse staff executing assigned packing and package creation work.

roles.name: Warehouse Operator
roles.description: Cross-functional warehouse operator handling receiving, picking, and packing.

roles.name: Warehouse Manager
roles.description: Warehouse supervisor controlling inventory, layout, counts, and fulfillment.

roles.name: Delivery Agent
roles.description: Delivery staff updating only assigned shipment and COD progress.

roles.name: Delivery Dispatcher
roles.description: Dispatcher assigning shipments and coordinating delivery routes.

roles.name: Logistics Manager
roles.description: Logistics supervisor managing carriers, shipments, routes, and exceptions.

roles.name: Procurement Officer
roles.description: Procurement staff managing suppliers, requisitions, orders, returns, and invoices.

roles.name: Procurement Manager
roles.description: Procurement supervisor approving sourcing and supplier financial workflows.

roles.name: Seller Administrator
roles.description: Seller-side administrator maintaining own listings and operational visibility.

roles.name: Marketplace Manager
roles.description: Platform staff onboarding sellers and managing listings and commissions.

roles.name: Catalog Manager
roles.description: Merchandising staff maintaining products, categories, content, and search metadata.

roles.name: Pricing Manager
roles.description: Commercial staff maintaining prices, promotions, coupons, and tax rules.

roles.name: Support Agent
roles.description: Customer-support staff handling permitted account, order, payment, and delivery queries.

roles.name: Support Manager
roles.description: Support supervisor handling escalations, returns, cancellations, and eligible refunds.

roles.name: Finance Analyst
roles.description: Read-focused finance staff reviewing payments, invoices, settlements, and ledgers.

roles.name: Finance Manager
roles.description: Finance supervisor responsible for refunds, chargebacks, reconciliation, and ledger posting.

roles.name: Insurance Coordinator
roles.description: Insurance operations staff managing eligibility, policies, and claims.

roles.name: Insurance Manager
roles.description: Insurance supervisor maintaining plans and overseeing claims operations.

roles.name: Compliance Auditor
roles.description: Read-only compliance access to regulated records and audit evidence.

roles.name: Compliance Officer
roles.description: Compliance staff managing consent, privacy, regulatory, and adverse-event workflows.

roles.name: Risk Analyst
roles.description: Risk staff reviewing fraud, abuse, account, payment, and operational signals.

roles.name: Risk Manager
roles.description: Risk supervisor managing decision rules, blocklists, and escalations.

roles.name: Organization Administrator
roles.description: Tenant or provider administrator managing workforce, facilities, and scoped role assignments.

roles.name: Operations Manager
roles.description: Operations staff coordinating orders, fulfillment, warehouse, support, and delivery.

roles.name: Identity Administrator
roles.description: Security administrator managing accounts, profiles, sessions, roles, permissions, and API clients.

roles.name: Platform Administrator
roles.description: Broad non-clinical platform administrator. Clinical authoring, clinical verification, and permission-definition changes remain separated.

roles.name: Super Administrator
roles.description: Emergency platform owner with every permission managed by this manifest.
